verdict.rationale: Rootly's own docs describe a broad set of in-product AI features built on the customer's data. AI Summaries generate titles, summaries, catchups and status write-ups from incident data, and an in-app AI chat answers questions grounded in each incident's timeline, alerts and transcripts. AI blocks draft retrospective sections, Related Incidents matches the current incident against past ones, and AI SRE returns a reviewable diagnosis with recommended next steps; the AI is also available in Slack and on mobile. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of these insights and suggestions (all evidence is vendor-claimed).
